informed_by: Reviewed2023–2025 usage-transition development errors; not fresh independent validation
hypothesis: Retain individual workload variation by predicting a signed workload change relative to the player own latest reconciled season, rather than replacing the player with an absolute peer mean.
chronology: Fit strictly earlier targets, maximum2025. Origin2026 means final coefficient freeze through2025, not evaluation of2026. No2026 target errors, forecasts or new2027 predictions in this build.
anchor: Latest prior completed season only: source season Y-1, normalized by that season observed maximum team games. Missing is unknown; use zero only with source-reconciled zero or the separate certified participation ledger. No fallback to an older or peak season.
response: Residual = target joint workload/target observed calendar minus anchor joint workload/anchor observed calendar. Preserve signed components, all nonappearances and declines. Unknown/conflicting rows remain excluded/fallback, never imputed.
estimator: One unconditional residual mean per registered pool; root sample mean and child (sum residual+50×parent mean)/(n+50). Preserve root→latest_state→latest/recent/experience hierarchy. No search or fitted coefficient multiplying the anchor; anchor coefficient fixed at1.
departure_from_failed_model: Replace absolute probability-weighted conditional workload means with a signed residual point estimator plus personal anchor. No state-probability output: nonappearance risk enters through observed zero target residuals, not a claim of calibrated medical probabilities.
support: Retain >=200 known global/cell cases, >=20 positive and20 zero, >=20 each active global state, pitcher >=50 pure-start and100 pure-relief target seasons. Same deterministic sparse-pool backoff; no support threshold reduction.
states_and_secondary_roles: Retain frozen pre-origin state definitions, last60 source and history bins. Retain predictor-time secondary pitcher batting fallback (>=5 pitching G and <100 PA). No current charts, age, injury features, translations or Statcast.
projection: Prediction normalized = own anchor + selected mean residual; multiply by explicit planned calendar(default162). Clip negative components to0, with no positive workload floor. Hitter BATTING_G<=MLB_G and STARTS<=BATTING_G; pitcher G=GS+GR and OUTS=START_OUTS+RELIEF_OUTS. Infeasible positive PA without batting G or positive outing outs without corresponding appearances returns full-baseline fallback. Expose raw vector and feasibility edits.
freshness_protocol: Build a shared pre-origin ledger for BOTH comparator arms: reconciled positive exposure =>RECENT_POSITIVE; reconciled/certified zero=>KNOWN_ZERO_RECENT; otherwise UNKNOWN_RECENT. Keep separate actual MLB appearance and exposure labels. Do not inject ledger zeros into baseline historical numeric inputs or change baseline forecasts.
exceptions: Jansen2024 excluded as a target and required latest anchor for2025. Jeffers/Keys2026 remain quarantined outside this historical build. Do not repair source counts.
comparison: Preserve frozen full cohort, eligible target policy and fallback reporting. Future scorer must use shared ledger and identical metric memberships for both arms. Preserve baseline original-context columns for provenance; do not rewrite old failed-run guards.
adoption: No automatic adoption. Full count, skill preservation and team-opportunity handling remain mandatory future work even after any workload pass.
present_build: Register code/contracts before panel preparation; synthetic tests and historical label/support counts only. No historical fitting, forecast-error scoring, calibrated uncertainty intervals or forecasts.
illustrations: Stewart and Misiorowski remain unscored published-history illustrations; no new numerical candidate projection for them.
future_validation: Existing earlier-only guards remain necessary; repeated2023–2025 development tests are not an untouched holdout. Any future independent evidence must be labeled separately.
